Bang Bang air fryer chicken  If your looking for an easy and delicious chicken recipe that comes together in no time make this bang bang chicken, I served it over some white rice.  ——Ingredients—— 3 chicken breasts  1 teaspoon garlic powder  1 teaspoon onion powder  1 teaspoon paprika  1 teaspoon seasoned salt  : ——bang bang sauce—— 1 cup mayonnaise  1/2 cup sweet chili sauce  2 tablespoon chili garlic sauce or Sriracha  : 1. Score the chicken breasts about 1/8-inch deep and 1/2-inch apart. Make cross-hatch cuts. Mix all the spices together (garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoned salt) and season the chicken breasts on both sides.  2. Make the bang bang sauce - mix together the Mayo, sweet chili sauce and chili garlic sauce or sriracha. Make sure you reserve about a couple tablespoons of the sauce for drizzling on top when serving the dish.  3. Place the chicken breasts in the air fryer basket and spread about 2 tablespoons of the bang bang sauce on top, then air fry at 390° for about 20 minutes depending on the size of the chicken breasts or until the internal temperature hits 165 degrees. 4. Once done let the chicken rest for about 10 minutes , then serve over white rice drizzle with the reserved bang bang sauce, garnish with some cilantro or green onions and enjoy.  #bangbangchicken #airfryer #recipe #family #favorite #easyrecipe #mealideas

Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

crispy chicken caesar salad wrap 🌯🍽️  and thank you SO much for 500k 🫶🏽🥹   recipe:    4 chicken breasts  1 cup all-purpose flour (120g)   seasonings (to taste): salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, italian seasoning, chili powder, kinder bold chicken seasoning blend ( i used this to season the chicken and flour )    for the wet mixture : 2 eggs 2–3 tbsp heavy cream (30–45g) 1–2 tbsp pickle juice     panko: 1½ cups panko breadcrumbs (90g) 2–3 tbsp grated parmesan (optional)    other ingredients: romaine lettuce tortillas  extra parmesan oil for frying   season the chicken generously with your spices. in one bowl, mix the flour with any remaining seasoning. in another bowl, whisk the eggs, cream, and pickle juice. in a third bowl, combine the panko and parmesan. coat each piece of chicken in the flour, then the egg mixture, then press into the panko until fully coated. let the breaded chicken rest for 5–10 minutes so the coating sticks. fry in oil over medium heat until golden and cooked through, about 4–5 minutes per side. remove and let drain    caesar dressing 1 cup mayo (240g) ½ cup finely grated parmesan (50g) 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp lemon juice (30g) 1 tbsp dijon mustard (15g) 1 tsp worcestershire ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ cup olive oil (60g) 2–4 tbsp water (to thin if needed)   for the dressing, whisk together the mayo, parmesan, garlic, lemon juice, dijon, worcestershire, salt, and pepper. slowly whisk in the olive oil, then add water as needed until smooth and pourable. toss chopped romaine with some of the dressing. assemble the wraps with dressing, lettuce, crispy chicken, & extra parmesan. wrap tightly, and enjoy.    #caesarsalad #crispychicken #wraps #EasyRecipe #Recipe

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

HOT HONEY GROUND BEEF BOWLS 🍯🌶️ all I have to say is this one’s viral for a reason. Here’s how I made mine! Ingredients: (makes 4 bowls) 1 1/2 lbs sweet potato (680 g) peeled, diced into ~1/4” cubes salt, pepper, cinnamon - to taste 1 lb 93/7 lean ground beef 1 tbsp tomato paste (16 g) 1 tbsp taco seasoning 2 cups 2% low fat cottage cheese (452 g) 4 small avocados (400 g) 4 tbsp hot honey (84 g) Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425F and line a half baking sheet with parchment. 2. Add diced sweet potatoes, lightly spray with cooking spray and season with salt, pepper and a little cinnamon. Bake for 30 minutes, flipping and seasoning again halfway. 3. While potatoes are baking, make the taco beef. Heat a frying pan on medium high, add ground beef and cook, breaking apart into small pieces until fully cooked (~5 min). Drain any excess liquid. 4. Add tomato paste, taco seasoning, a splash of water and cook for 1-2 more minutes, stirring everything together. Remove from heat. 5. Build your bowl with sweet potato, taco beef, cottage cheese and fresh avocado. Finish it off with a drizzle of hot honey and enjoy! ✨ For the full printable recipe + nutrition, search 🔍 “hot honey ground beef bowls” at myproteinpantry.com or link 🔗 in my bio! 🫶🏼 #highprotein #easyrecipes #healthyfood #healthylifestyle #healthyrecipes #hothoney #beef #sweetpotato #avocado

High Protein Honey Garlic Butter Chicken Mac n Cheese!🍗🍯🧀 Absolutely one of the best combos, so indulgent, bursting with flavour and packed with 60g of protein! Macros Per Serving (4 Total) 597 Calories | 59g Protein | 52g Carbs | 16g Fat Ingredients (Makes 4) Honey Garlic Chicken - 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Black Pepper - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) - 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder - 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika - 2 Tsp Olive Oil - 30g Light Butter (Brand: Lurpak) for cooking + extra once cooked - 2 Tsp Minced Garlic - 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) - Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside Garlic Mac n Cheese - Big Tbsp Minced Garlic - 300ml Skimmed Milk - 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) - 1 Tsp Salt or to taste - 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper - 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) - 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) - 220g Uncooked Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter of the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then Serve & ENJOY! . . . . #garlicbutter #honeygarlic #chicken #chickenrecipes #macncheese #macaroni #pasta #macandcheese #highprotein #mealprep #foodie #healthyrecipes #weightloss #lowcalorie #eathealthy #fitness #mealprepideas

Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

INGREDIENTS Chicken & Marinade 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs 1 lemon, zested ⅛ cup soy sauce ¼ cup maple syrup 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp smoked paprika Glaze 2 tbsp butter 4 cloves garlic, minced ½ cup maple syrup ⅓ cup soy sauce 2 tbsp rice vinegar 3 tsp Momofuku chili oil 1 tsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (slurry) INSTRUCTIONS 1.In a bowl add chicken thighs and season with soy sauce, maple syrup, lemon zest, garlic powder, and smoked paprika, coat well. 2.Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. ⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Crockpot Mongolian Beef & Noodles 🥩🍜🔥 Crockpot Series Episode 7: Mongolian Beef & Noodles This is my crockpot series, where I help you make easy recipes so good you might find a spouse or impress the one you’ve got. Tender chuck roast, a sweet and savory Mongolian-style sauce, and noodles coated in all that flavor. We sear the beef for extra color, then the crockpot does the work and you take the credit! 🙌🏽🔥 Ingredients: 2 pounds thinly sliced chuck roast 4 tablespoons butter, for searing 1 cup low-sodium shoyu 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup low-sodium beef broth 2 tablespoons minced garlic 1 tablespoon grated ginger 2 tablespoon sesame oil 2 tablespoons rice vinegar 1 teaspoon black pepper 2 tablespoons cornstarch 2 tablespoons cold water 12 ounces precooked lo mein noodles. I used yakisoba noodles brand is Fortune. Sliced green onions Sesame seeds, optional Instructions: 1. Season your beef with SPG or your favorite seasoning. Heat a skillet over high heat with the butter and sear the beef in small batches for 1-2 minutes per side. You’re building color, not cooking it through. 2. Transfer the beef to the crockpot. Deglaze the skillet with a splash of the measured beef broth, scrape up those browned bits, and pour everything into the crockpot. 3. Add the remaining broth, shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and black pepper. Stir gently. 4. Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or HIGH for 2.5 to 3.5 hours. Start checking early so the thin beef stays tender without falling apart. 5. Mix the cornstarch slurry with a cup of broth. Stir the slurry into the sauce and cook on HIGH for 15–20 minutes, until thick and glossy. 6. Slice the green onions into 1 inch piece. Separate the precooked noodles and add them directly to the crockpot. Toss everything together and heat on HIGH for 5–10 minutes. 7. Finish with sliced green onions, sesame seeds, and chili crisp oil if you want some heat then serve immediately. Don’t leave those noodles sitting on KEEP WARM—they’ll keep drinking up the sauce. Save this one for an easy weeknight dinner! 🍜🔥 #crockpotrecipes #crockpot #EasyRecipe #hawaiitiktok #mongolianbeef

videos.caption: Here is my One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta Dinner 🤤🍝 full recipe on my website.  Crispy on the outside, juicy and full of flavor chicken over a rich, creamy, cheesy pasta. Easy comfort food made in one pot! No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 15–30 minutes for the best flavor. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. Garnish with fresh parsley, Parmesan cheese, or red pepper flakes if desired. #easyrecipe  #pasta #chicken #familydinner #onepot

Day 19 | 20 Days of 20 Minute Summer Dinners 😋 Simple deliciousness at its finest! To save time you can prep the 2nd half of the recipe as the chicken fries. Enjoy! Chris x CHICKEN FRANCESE | Serves 4 INGREDIENTS ➡️CHICKEN 2x 250g/9oz Chicken Breasts, close to room temp 35g / 1/4 cup Plain Flour 3/4 tsp Salt 1/2 tsp EACH: Black Pepper, Garlic Powder 2 Eggs 20g / 1/4 cup Parmesan (I use the refrigerated dusty stuff) 1 1/2 tbsp Olive Oil 1 tbsp/15g Unsalted Butter ➡️SAUCE 1 large Lemon, slice 4 thin rings from the centre then squeeze 1 tbsp juice from the ends 60ml / 1/4 cup Dry White Wine 180ml / 3/4 cup Chicken Stock 4 tbsp/60g Unsalted Butter, diced into small cubes (keep in the fridge until needed) 2 tbsp finely diced Fresh Chives METHOD 1️⃣Take two large shallow dishes. In the 1st combine the flour & seasoning and in the 2nd beat the egg & whisk in the parmesan. Lay two chicken breasts on a chopping board and horizontally slice them right through the centre to create 4 even-sized breasts. Individually coat each of them in the flour then return to the chopping board. 2️⃣Add 1 1/2 tbsp oil & 1 tbsp butter to a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Place the bowl with the egg next to the pan, then one by one coat the chicken in the egg, allow excess to drip off, then place in the pan. Cook each side for around 3mins, or until golden on the outside and just about cooked right through the centre. Remove the chicken from the pan and place on a plate to one side. Add the lemon slices to the pan and fry for around 20 secs each side, just until they start to soften & lightly colour. Remove from the pan (don't rest on the chicken). 3️⃣Pour in the wine and rapid simmer for around 2mins, or until it has mostly evaporated, deglazing the pan as needed. Pour in the stock and 1 tbsp lemon juice (you can adjust this later) and bring to a simmer. 4️⃣Add the cubed butter to the leftover flour then toss coat. Add the floured butter to the pan and swiftly whisk until it blends into the stock. Add the chives and continue simmering and stirring until the sauce turns cloudy and thickens slightly to a glossy texture. Generously season to taste. 5️⃣Add the chicken alongside any resting juices and place then lemon slices on top. Baste in the sauce to warm it back through then serve and enjoy.

Butter Chicken Recipe 🍛🔥👇🏼  For chicken:   2 chicken breast   3 tbsp Greek yogurt   Minced ginger   1 tsp garlic powder, paprika, cayenne, salt, cumin   1/2 lemon   For sauce:   1 tbsp butter   1/2 onion   2 fresh cloves garlic   1/2 tsp paprika, cumin, salt and chicken bouillon powder (optional)   2 1/4 cup tomato passata   1-2 tsp sugar   1 cup heavy cream   2 tbsp butter   cilantro   First, we’re going to cut the chicken into small cubes and season it with the spices, fresh ginger, lemon, and Greek yogurt. Then in a pan, add oil and fry the chicken.   Meanwhile, finely chop the onion and garlic.   Once the chicken is ready, remove it from the pan. In the same pan, add a small piece of butter and fry the onion, garlic, and spices together for 5 minutes over low heat until softened. Then add the tomato passata, sugar, and heavy cream. Mix very well and cook for a couple of minutes, then add two small pieces of butter to make it extra creamy. Finally, add the fried chicken back in, mix everything together, and top with cilantro and a little heavy cream. Serve it with white rice and naan bread.   👀 Remember that seasonings are always to taste, so don’t be afraid to add more if needed. Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

Place on parchment paper, cover, and let rise again for 30–45 minutes. 6. Heat oil to 170°C (340°F) and fry for about 2 minutes per side, until golden brown. 7. Drain on paper towels, brush lightly with melted butter, and coat in sugar while still warm. 8. Once slightly cooled, use a piping nozzle to make a hole in each Bombolini and fill 4 with Kinder Bueno spread and 4 with Nutella. 9. ✨Crispy Chicken Ceasar Wrap 🌯 Ingredients: For the chicken: * 500g chicken breast * 1 tsp cayenne pepper * 1 tsp black pepper * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp red chilli flakes * 1 tsp dried parsley * 3 tbsp oil For the coating: * 2 cups plain flour + the same seasonings used for the chicken * 1 cup breadcrumbs * 1 tbsp Parmesan cheese * 2 eggs + ¾ cup water For the Caesar dressing: * 2 cups mayonnaise * 2 tbsp mustard sauce * 2–3 minced garlic cloves * ½ tsp black pepper * ½ tsp garlic powder * A pinch of salt * ½ cup Parmesan cheese * 2 tbsp olive oil * ⅓ cup water, or more as needed For the wrap: * Tortillas * Lettuce * Cooked chicken * Caesar dressing * Fries * Extra Parmesan cheese Method * Chicken: Marinate the chicken with all the seasonings and oil for at least 30 minutes. Coat in seasoned flour, dip in the egg mixture, then breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan. Fry over medium heat for about 8 minutes, until golden and fully cooked. * Caesar dressing: Mix all the dressing ingredients, gradually adding water until smooth and creamy. Set some aside for dipping, then mix the rest with the lettuce. * Assemble: Spread Caesar dressing on a tortilla, add the Caesar salad, crispy chicken, extra dressing, Parmesan and fries. Fold tightly. * Crisp: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Cook the wraps for about 2 minutes on each side until golden and crispy. Enjoy!🤍 #chickenceaserwrap #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickrecipes #wraps

Recipe👇🏽 Nashville Hot Mozzarella Sticks Just Got Crispier🌶️🔥 These mozzarella sticks just got a serious upgrade. Double-breaded, fried until golden and crispy, then tossed in a Nashville hot oil that brings the heat. Mozzarella Sticks 3 rectangles low-moisture mozzarella, sliced into ½–1 inch sticks Flour, for dusting 2 eggs, beaten 1½ cups breadcrumbs Oil, for frying Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp cayenne 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp brown sugar Slice the low-moisture mozzarella into ½–1 inch sticks and lightly dust them in flour. Freeze for 1 hour. Dip the frozen mozzarella into the egg, then breadcrumbs, then back into the egg and breadcrumbs again. Heat your oil to 350°F and fry the mozzarella straight from frozen for 2–3 minutes, until golden and crispy. You’ll know they’re ready when they float to the top and look nice and puffy. Don’t overcrowd the pan. While they’re frying, mix the Nashville hot oil ingredients together. As soon as the mozzarella sticks come out, brush or toss them in the hot oil while they’re still steaming. Serve immediately with ranch. I hope it crunches.

Just to clarify, this video was never meant to be racist in any way. I was speaking purely from an artistic perspective. As I'm starting to learn coloring, I naturally find some skin tones more challenging to render than others. That doesn't mean I like them any less. In fact, both my mom's and my dad's sides of the family are Black. My mom herself has dark skin, so why would I dislike the same skin tone as my own family? The same goes for hair textures. I have naturally curly/coily hair, and from an artistic point of view, I personally find it more difficult to draw and render than straight hair. That doesn't mean I don't like it—in fact, I love my hair. It's simply about the technical challenge of drawing and coloring different features, nothing more. Please don't confuse artistic difficulty with personal preference or prejudice. They're two completely different things.  #dessin #black #fyp #drawing #fypシ゚

Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

One-Pan Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls 🔥 All the shawarma flavor, none of the extra steps… juicy spiced chicken, onion rice pilaf, refreshing salad and a creamy garlic sauce 🤌 For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp onion powder, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp allspice, 2 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp salt -3 tbsp olive oil + 8 garlic cloves -½ lemon, juiced -2 tsp bouillon (I used the roasted chicken base from @Better Than Bouillon) For the Rice: -3 tbsp butter + 1 ½ cups yellow onion, diced -1 tbsp turmeric, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp pepper -1 ½ cups basmati rice -3 cups hot water  -3 tsp bouillon  For the Fresh Sumac Salad: -½ large red onion, thinly sliced -1 cup cherry tomatoes, quartered -1 cup cucumber, sliced then halved -1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper & 2 tsp sumac -½ lemon, juiced For the Garlic Sauce: -¼ cup mayonnaise + ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt -2 to 3 garlic cloves + 1 tbsp fresh parsley -1 tsp salt + 1 tsp black pepper -½ lemon, juiced + 1 tbsp olive oil 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and bouillon. Mix well. Marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside. 3. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add butter to the same pan then the onions & cook, stirring often, until translucent. Add the garlic & spices, cook for 1 to 2 mins. Add the rice and toast for 2 mins while stirring. Pour in the hot water mixed with bouillon according to package instructions. Stir & bring to a boil. Once boiling, cover & reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20 mins until cooked. 4. Mix the salad ingredients in one bowl and the sauce ingredients in another bowl. Enjoy! #dinner #easyrecipe #homecooking #tiktokrecipe #fyp #shawarma #chickenrecipe #cookingathometiktoktv

For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Recipe Name: Slow Cooker Creamy Garlic Parmesan Pork Chops Ingredients 1. 4 bone-in pork chops 2. 1 tsp salt 3. 1/2 tsp black pepper 4. 1 tsp garlic powder 5. 1 tsp onion powder 6. 1 tbsp olive oil 7. 3 tbsp butter 8. 4 cloves garlic, minced 9. 1 cup chicken broth 10. 1 cup heavy cream 11. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 13. 1/2 tsp paprika 14. 1 tbsp cornstarch 15. 2 tbsp water 16. 2 tbsp chopped parsley Recipe 1. Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels. 2. Season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Sear the pork chops for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown. 5. Transfer the pork chops to a slow cooker. 6. In the same skillet, melt butter and sauté the garlic for 30 seconds. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up any browned bits from the pan. 8. Stir in the heavy cream, Parmesan cheese, and Italian seasoning. 9. Pour the creamy mixture over the pork chops in the slow cooker. 10. Cover and cook on LOW for 5–6 hours or HIGH for 2½–3 hours. 11. Mix cornstarch and water in a small bowl until smooth. 12. Stir the slurry into the slow cooker during the last 20 minutes of cooking. 13. Let the sauce thicken while the pork chops finish cooking. 14. Spoon the creamy garlic Parmesan sauce over the pork chops. 15. Garnish with fresh parsley before serving. 16. Serve hot with mashed potatoes, rice, or roasted vegetables. One Pan Cheesy Parmesan Garlic Chicken & Rice 😮‍💨 INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breast, cut into cubes  2 tbsp butter  1 onion, chopped  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 tsp each of smoked paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning   1 tbsp minced garlic BWW Parmesan Garlic Sauce  2 cups of chicken broth  1 cup white jasmine rice, rinsed   1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese  2 oz cream cheese 4 pieces of bacon, cooked and crumbled Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  If you don’t have any bacon leftover from breakfast cook your bacon, drain the grease, and chop it into small pieces. To keep this recipe even easier you could use bacon bits  Cut 1 lb of chicken into small pieces. Add butter to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and spread out evenly in pan. Add the chopped onion and season with salt, pepper, paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning.  Once the chicken is almost cooked add the minced garlic and add 2-3 tbsp of Parmesan garlic sauce to the pan and stir. Add the rinsed rice to the center of the skillet and let toast for a couple of minutes. Add the chicken broth to the skillet and stir well. Stir well.  Top with more cheese and the crumbled bacon. Cover with the lid to let the cheese melt or pop it in the oven under the broiler for just a few minutes.  Top with dried parsley.  Enjoy! Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn't brown before the cheese melts. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and Parmesan and serve immediately with the reserved garlic Parmesan dipping sauce. #recipe #garlicparmesan #chickenrolls

Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Breast Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp salt 8. 1/2 tsp black pepper 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp garlic powder 13. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Sear the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 4. Remove the chicken and keep warm. 5. Melt the butter in the same pan. 6. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, stirring well. 8. Add Parmesan cheese and cook until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 3–5 minutes so the flavors combine. 11. Garnish with fresh parsley. 12. Serve with mashed potatoes, pasta, or roasted vegetables. Follow for more delicious recipes!

New York Times Top 50 Recipes of 2025 | Smashed Beef Kabob with Cucumber Yogurt @nytcooking @zaynab_issa - 2 cups Greek yogurt - 2 mini cucumbers - 3 tbsp mint - 1 large garlic clove - 1 pound ground beef (80/20) - 1 small yellow onion - ½ tsp ground turmeric - 2 tsp salt - black pepper - ¼ cup walnut halves - 2 tbsp cranberries - Pomegranate molasses, optional, for serving - Warmed pita or white rice, for serving Combine the yogurt, cucumbers, chopped mint, and garlic in a medium bowl, mix well, and chill until ready to serve. In a separate bowl, thoroughly mix the beef, onion, turmeric, 1 teaspoon of salt, and plenty of black pepper. Heat a large, well-seasoned cast-iron skillet over medium-high until very hot, then drop the beef into the pan in large, irregular chunks, cooking undisturbed for 6 to 8 minutes until charred and crisp on the bottom. Toss the meat with a wooden spoon to break up any extra-large pieces, then stir in the walnuts and raisins, cooking for another 2 to 3 minutes until the meat is done and the walnuts are toasted. Finally, season the chilled yogurt with the remaining 1 teaspoon of salt, spread it across the bottom of a serving platter, layer the crispy meat on top, and finish with a drizzle of optional pomegranate molasses, fresh mint leaves, and a side of warmed pita or rice. #kabob #FoodTok #nyt #cooking #beef

High Protein Creamy Garlic Herb Cajun Chicken🍗🔥 Easily the best chicken i’ve made, so easy, low effort and simple to meal prep! Paired perfectly with a side of fluffy mash and creamy sauce Macros Per Serving (4 Total) 543 Calories | 53g Protein | 45g Carbs | 14g Fat Ingredients (Makes 4 Servings) Garlic Herb Cajun Chicken - 800g Raw Chicken Thighs boneless skinless - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 1.5 Tsp Parsley - 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder - 1.5 Tsp Paprika - 2 Tsp Olive Oil Oven Bake or Air Fry for 22-25mins at 200C / 400F. You can cook these on a pan in some butter too for 4-5 mins each side on medium heat Light & Fluffy Mash - 800g Raw White Potatoes peeled and diced into 1 inch chuncks - 20g Room Temperature Light Butter (Brand: Norpak) - 125ml (1/2 Cup) Warm Skimmed Milk - 1.5 Tsp Salt or to taste - 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder Place potatoes in a pot of cold water, bring to a boil then boil for 12-14mins till fork tender. Then drain the water and cover with a lid so it steams for about 5mins. Then uncover and mash using a ricer or masher. Use room temp butter and warm milk Creamy Cajun Sauce - 10g Light Butter (Brand: Norpak) - 3/4 Tsp Each Salt, Italian Herbs, Chilli Flakes, Garlic, Onion Powder, Parsley Paprika - 250ml (1 Cup) Skimmed Milk - 40g Grated Parmigiano Cheese - Good Handful Chopped Spinach Toast the spices in butter for 2mins on low heat then add milk, cream cheese, parmesan and spinach. Keep stirring till smooth, creamy and slightly thick. Let this warm up for 3-4 mins and your sauce is ready - Slice your chicken into cubes then serve with the fluffy mash. I recommend storing the creamy sauce separately and serving when ready to eat ENJOY! . . . . #chickenrecipes #chicken  #cajunchicken #garlic #mashedpotatoes #potato #creamychicken #mealprep #highprotein #weightloss #healthyrecipes #foodie #fitness #easyrecipes #mealprepideas

Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🔥  For all of you asking about the app I made (it’s free!!) you can search “osta” on the App Store or Google Play 😁 A little sweet, a little spicy and majorly crispy… served with buttermilk ranch.  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Hot Honey Sauce: -1/4 cup butter -2 to 3 tbsps hot sauce -1/3 cup honey For the Ranch:  -1/2 cup mayonnaise + 1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup cold buttermilk (use less for a thicker dip) -1 teaspoon red wine vinegar  -1 teaspoon dried parsley -1 tbsp fresh dill weed (or 1 tsp dried dill) -Spices: 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper -1 tbsp fresh chives, optional Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick. Add to a mixing bowl with buttmilk, pickle juice, & chicken seasonings. Mix together. Cover & refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Keep the oil around this temp at all times.  4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture & stir to create flaky bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, coat each piece in the flour mixture. Shake off extra flour & place into the oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins. Fry for 7–8 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to wire rack.  6. Meanwhile, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add honey and 2–3 tbsp hot sauce and whisk until smooth.  7. Mix the ranch ingredients in a bowl.  8. Toss or brush the tenders with the hot honey sauce. Serve with buttermilk ranch & enjoy! #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #recipesoftiktok #easydinner

✨Hot Honey Crispy Chicken Burgers 🍔  Ingredients For the chicken: * 500g chicken, cut into burger-sized pieces * 300ml buttermilk * 1 tbsp white vinegar * 2 tbsp hot sauce * 1 egg * 1 tbsp paprika * 1 tsp black pepper * 1 tbsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * ½ tsp salt For the dry coating: * 2 cups plain flour * 2 cups cornstarch * Same seasonings as the chicken For the garlic mayo sauce: * 2 cups mayonnaise * 2 tbsp water * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp onion powder * ½ tsp black pepper * Pinch of salt * 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley * Squeeze of lemon juice For the hot honey glaze: * 6–7 tbsp butter * 1 tbsp oil * 2 tbsp hot sauce * 3 tbsp honey For assembly: * 4 burger buns * Pickles Method * Marinate: Mix the buttermilk, vinegar, hot sauce, egg and chicken seasonings. Add the chicken and marinate for 30–40 minutes. * Coat: Mix the flour, cornstarch and seasonings. Coat each chicken piece in the flour mixture, dip back into the marinade, then coat in the flour again. * Fry: Deep-fry immediately in hot oil until golden, crispy and cooked through. * Hot honey glaze: Melt the butter with the oil, then mix in the hot sauce and honey. Reserve some for the buns and coat the crispy chicken with the rest. * Sauce: Mix all the sauce ingredients until smooth. * Assemble: Spread garlic mayo on the buns, add the crispy chicken and pickles, then close the burgers. Brush the tops with the reserved hot honey glaze and serve with extra sauce. Enjoy! 🤍 #cookingtips #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickrecipes #burger

LOADED BUFFALO CHICKEN POTATOES 🍟  These were so delicious and easy to make! Perfect for a high protein lunch or dinner option. Save for later☝🏼 •546 kcals  •44g PRO, 65g CHO, 18g FAT For 1 serving: -250g of potato -2 tsp of aromat seasoning  -1 tsp of olive oil or use low cal spray -1 tsp of paprika -1 tsp of garlic granules -Salt/pepper -100g of uncooked chicken breast -15g of light mozzarella/cheddar -1 tbsp of light ranch (mixed with 1 tbsp of water) -Fresh parsley, chopped Buffalo sauce: -2 tbsp of Franks Red Hot Buffalo Sauce -1 tbsp of light ranch -15g of light cream cheese  Method: 1. Wash the potatoes then slice into cubes. Par boil for 5 minutes then drain. Season with aromat seasoning. Spray with oil, toss and air fry or cook in the oven at 200°C for 20-25 minutes. 2. Season the chicken with 1 tsp of paprika, garlic granules, salt and pepper.  3. Air fry at 180°C for 15-20 minutes. 4. Once cooked, add to a bowl and shred apart with two forks. 5. Whisk together the buffalo sauce, ranch and cream cheese. Then add the chicken and shred apart.  6. Add the cooked potatoes to an oven safe dish and top with the buffalo chicken. Sprinkle over the mozzarella/cheddar and place under the grill for 5 minutes or until the cheese has melted. 7. Remove from the grill. Mix together 1 tbsp of ranch with 1 tbsp of water and drizzle over the fries. Sprinkle over fresh parsley. Enjoy! #loadedfries #buffalofries #buffalochicken #cheesy #highproteinrecipes

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

The Arctic Fox (Vulpes lagopus), sometimes called the snow fox, is a small but remarkably hardy fox adapted to some of the coldest environments on Earth. Its thick fur changes with the seasons white during winter to blend into snow and brown or grey in summer to camouflage against rocks and vegetation. Its compact body, short ears, and furry paws help conserve heat in freezing conditions. Arctic foxes are symbols of adaptability, resilience, intelligence, and survival. They inhabit Arctic tundra across the Northern Hemisphere and can withstand temperatures far below freezing while searching for rodents, birds, eggs, fish, and carrion. Fun fact: An Arctic fox can survive temperatures approaching −50°C (−58°F), partly because its thick winter coat provides exceptional insulation. #ArcticFox #SnowFox #VulpesLagopus #Wildlife #Winter

RESTORATION STEW ✨  A nourishing beef stew made with your period in mind. This rich ginger-braised beef stew combines iron-rich beef and lentils, sweet potato, spinach, ginger, pumpkin seeds and vitamin C-rich red pepper and lemon. And because nourishment should still be delicious, there’s red wine, white miso and a little dark chocolate for serious depth. Save this one for the next time your body is asking for a little extra care. 🥩 BEEF • 1½ lb (680g) cubed chuck roast • 1 lb (454g) cubed boneless short rib • 1½ tsp kosher salt • ¾ tsp black pepper • 2 tbsp olive oil 🥣 STEW • 8 oz (227g) sliced cremini mushrooms • 1 yellow onion, diced • 1 red bell pepper, diced • 5 garlic cloves, minced • 2 tbsp grated ginger • 2 tbsp tomato paste • 1 tsp turmeric • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ½ cup (120ml) dry red wine • 6 cups (1.4L) low-sodium beef stock • 3 thyme sprigs • 1 large sweet potato, cubed • ¾ cup (145g) red lentils, rinsed • 1 tbsp (18g) white/shiro miso • ¾ oz (21g) 70–85% dark chocolate • 3 cups (90g) baby spinach • 1–2 tbsp lemon juice FINISH • ⅓ cup (45g) roasted pumpkin seeds • ¼ cup (15g) parsley • Olive oil + lemon DIRECTIONS 	1	Season beef. Heat oil in a Dutch oven and brown beef in batches. Remove. 	2	Brown mushrooms 4–5 min. Add onion + pepper; cook 4–5 min. Add garlic + ginger; cook 1 min. 	3	Stir in tomato paste, turmeric + paprika; cook 1–2 min. Add wine, scrape up those good brown bits and reduce 2–3 min. 	4	Return beef. Add stock + thyme. Cover and gently simmer 1½–2 hrs until tender. 	5	Remove thyme. Add sweet potato + lentils. Simmer uncovered 20–25 min until tender. Add more stock if needed. 	6	Whisk miso with ½ cup hot broth; stir into stew. Add chocolate and stir until melted. 	7	Add spinach until wilted. Turn off heat and add lemon. Season to taste. Serve with pumpkin seeds, parsley, olive oil + lemon. When your body is asking for a little extra care, feed her accordingly. ✨ #PeriodNutrition #BeefStewRecipe #IronRichFoods #ComfortFood #WickdConfections

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Prep chicken: Cut chicken into cubes. Coat in 1 Tbsp olive oil + seasonings. Set aside to let marinade. 2. Make rice: cook rice according to package. Mix in cilantro, lime, olive oil, gp, s&p. 3. Prep Dressing: make the Elote dressing by mixing the ingredients listed. 4. Make Street Corn: remove corn from cob & chop the jalapeno, red pepper, onion, & cilantro. Add everything to a  bowl. Top with more dressing, lime, & fave toppings!  NUTRITION (per bowl, makes 6)* 470 cal, 34g pro, 43g carb, 19g fat *nutrition info based on serving size rec: ½ c chicken, ½ c rice, ¾ c corn salad, 2 Tbsp dressing, ½ c romaine (opt) Follow for healthy recipes! Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

one pan taco mac & cheese 🤗 recipe is below! Taco Mac & Cheese Ingredients * 1 lb ground beef * 1 packet taco seasoning * 4 oz tomato sauce * ½ cup salsa * 16 oz shell pasta * 1 cup beef broth * 1 cup milk * 1½ cups Mexican blend cheese, divided * Optional: parsley for topping Instructions 1. In a large skillet over medium high heat, cook the ground beef with the taco seasoning until browned and fully cooked. 2. Add the tomato sauce and salsa, and stir until combined. 3. Add the uncooked shell pasta, beef broth, and milk. Mix well. 4. Bring to a simmer, reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is tender. If the pasta needs more time, continue cooking and add a splash of broth or milk as needed. 5. Once pasta is cooked, stir in 1¼ cups of mexican cheese until melted. 6. Sprinkle the remaining ¼ cup cheese over the top, cover, and let it melt. 7. Top with parsley if desired and serve warm! #easydinnerideas #dinnerideas #mealideas #dinner #onepanmeal

CHIPOTLE HONEY CHICKEN BOWLS CHICKEN 3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo* ¼ cup honey + more to drizzle ¼ cup olive oil + juice of 2 limes 1 Tbsp EACH garlic powder, onion powder + paprika 2 tsp EACH chili powder, cumin + oregano 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1 tsp black pepper Add everything to chicken, toss well + marinate. Spread on a sheet pan, drizzle with a little more honey + bake at 425°F for 20–25 min or until 165°F. Broil briefly at the end if you want more char. *Spicy: use the whole can, peppers + sauce. Mild: use the adobo sauce but leave out the peppers. CILANTRO-LIME RICE 3 cups long-grain rice + ¾–1 cup warm chicken broth + ½ cup cilantro + juice of 2 limes + 2 Tbsp olive oil + salt. Cook rice; while HOT, add cilantro, lime, oil + salt, then slowly add broth while fluffing until absorbed. CORN SALSA 3 cups corn (canned or frozen) + 1 diced jalapeño + ½ diced red onion + ½ bunch chopped cilantro + juice 1–2 limes + S&P. Mix. BLACK BEANS 2 cans black beans + 1 tsp cumin + salt + splash chicken broth. Warm together. PICO 4 tomatoes + ½ red onion + ½ bunch cilantro, all diced + juice 1–2 limes + salt. Mix. SHEET-PAN BEEF KEBABS 3 lb ground beef 1 large white onion + 1 red bell pepper 6 garlic cloves + 1 bunch parsley 2 Tbsp paprika + 1 Tbsp cumin 2 tsp EACH coriander + turmeric 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp cinnamon (optional) Food-process onion, pepper, garlic + parsley until finely chopped. Transfer to cheesecloth + squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Add to beef with all spices + hand mix. Press evenly onto a sheet pan. Use a bench scraper to make deep kebab-style rows as shown in the video. Bake at 425°F for ~15 min, carefully drain excess liquid/fat, then broil 3–5 min until browned. ROASTED PEPPERS + ONIONS 2 red + 2 yellow bell peppers + 2 red onions + 1 bunch scallions + 2 tsp EACH paprika + cumin + olive oil + S&P. Slice, toss + roast at 425°F for 20–25 min until tender + charred. QUICK TZATZIKI 2 cups Greek yogurt + 1 grated cucumber + 1 grated garlic clove + juice 1 lemon + ¼ cup dill + salt. Mix. Brush pita with olive oil + grill until lightly charred. Fill with tzatziki, beef kebab + roasted peppers and onions. MAPLE SWEET POTATOES 6 sweet potatoes, halved + a little olive oil + maple syrup. Rub all over, place CUT-SIDE DOWN + roast at 425°F until tender + deeply caramelized. BROCCOLI Broccoli florets + olive oil + garlic powder + S&P. Cheesy Chipotle Chicken Rice Bowls Air Fryer Only Episode 2 Per Serving (Makes 5) 585 Cals 52g Protein 57g Carbs 17g Fat — Chipotle Chicken: 900g skinless chicken thighs (32oz) 5g avocado oil (1 tsp) 20g hot honey (1 Tbsp) Juice of 1/2 lime Season heavily: Chipotle or ancho chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, salt Fajita Veggies: 2 bell peppers 1/2 yellow onion 10g oil (2 tsp) 15g tomato paste (1 tbsp) Rice: 300g / 2 cups rice (dry weight) Or ~580g pre-cooked rice  Finishing Ingredients: 60g reduced fat mozzarella (1/2 cup) 60g extra sharp cheddar (1/2 cup) 100g 0% Greek yogurt (1/2 cup) Handful chopped cilantro Smokey Chipotle Sauce: 180g 0% Greek yogurt (3/4 cup) 60g milk (1/4 cup) 7g honey (1 tsp) 45g adobo sauce (3 Tbsp) Smoked paprika to taste Salt to taste - Instructions 1.) In a bowl, mix chicken thighs with avocado oil, hot honey, lime juice, and all seasonings. Toss until evenly coated. 2.) Cook chicken in an air fryer at 375°F for 20-25 mins, flipping halfway, until cooked through and lightly charred. Remove and chop into bite-sized pieces. 3.) Remove the air fryer rack. Add diced bell peppers, onion, oil, and tomato paste directly to the basket. Air fry at 350°F for 10–15 minutes, stirring once or twice, until softened and lightly browned. 4.) Add cooked rice directly to the veggies in the air fryer basket (or transfer to a large bowl). Stir in mozzarella, cheddar, and Greek yogurt until melted and creamy. Add chopped chicken and cilantro. Mix until evenly combined. 5.) Whisk together Greek yogurt, milk, honey, adobo sauce, salt and smoked paprika until smooth. 6.) Divide into 5 equal servings and top each with smoky chipotle sauce. 9 Best Things to Do in Marrakesh 🕌✨ 1) Stay in a Riad 🛏️  feel the authentic Moroccan vibe, from the mosaic tiles to the whisper-quiet courtyards. Riads offer privacy, fewer crowds, and a home-away-from-home feel with traditional decor, often a peaceful rooftop terrace, and staff who treat you like family. Perfect for a truly Moroccan experience without the hotel hustle. 2) Best Coffee at Bacha Coffee ☕️✨ (Location: https://goo.gl/maps/6u3Xx9J9xqv1w9Qw7) Silky espresso, perfectly balanced blends, and a chic, relaxed atmosphere. Great latte art, friendly baristas, and a bright, stylish space to post your vibes. Pro tip: try their signature crush coffee and pastry pairing. 3) Explore the Souks 🧿🌀 Fun tip: haggle with a smile, never agree to the first price! Make it a playful game, sample spices, and test your bargaining skills. Lose yourself in ribbons of color, leather, pottery, and lamps. The thrill of the find is half the fun! 4) Visit Ben Youssef Madrasa 🕌 A jaw-dropping historic site with intricate tilework, carved wood, and serene courtyards. It’s a perfect spot for photos that scream old-world Marrakech charm. 5) Jardin Majorelle 🌿💙 iconic cobalt-blue paths, lush botanical displays, and a peaceful escape from the market buzz. A must-see for color lovers and plant enthusiasts, plus it’s connected to the Yves Saint Laurent legacy. 6) Ourika Valley Day Trip 🚙🌄 about 1 hour from central Marrakech (depending on traffic). What to expect: stunning valley scenery, Berber villages, waterfalls, and a cooler climate. A refreshing break from the medina with photo-worthy viewpoints. 7) Agafay Desert Experience 🐫🏜️ Highlights: camel ride under the open sky, squad  bike moments, and magical desert views. Luxe touch: stay at a desert camp with plush lounges, gourmet meals, and starlit dinners. Perfect for a memorable  outing. 8) Dinner at La Trattoria 🍝🇮🇹  warm, cozy ambiance with authentic Italian flavors in Marrakech. Great for a relaxed evening, fresh pastas, and a lively dining vibe after a day of exploration. 9) Jemaa el-Fnaa - The Heart of Marrakech 🎭💃 Do it for the vibes: bustling square, street performances, snake charmers, and a feast for the senses. Pro tip: bring some cash for photos with performers and for quick bites. Best times: late afternoon into evening when the energy peaks. #Marrakesh #Morocco #TravelTikTok #Riads #Souks

videos.caption: hands down the number 1 recipe I get tagged in with all of your beautiful remakes!! 🥰 it’s no surprise this one is so popular because it’s so so easy, made with simple ingredients, & tastes absolutely delicious!!  all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

Gelatine is a collagen-derived protein containing 18 amino acids and is especially rich in glycine, proline, and hydroxyproline, which help to support gut lining integrity by contributing to things like mucus production, epithelial repair, and tight-junction stability. It's been used for health purposes since ancient times across many cultures, yet modern diets are largely devoid of these connective-tissue-derived nutrients, despite a substantial and growing body of research. And no; there is no vegan alternative, and no; collagen peptides do not serve the same structural functions. Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. #Creamy #Queso #Chicken Enchiladas 🌮🧀 Tender chicken #enchiladas smothered in creamy queso blanco and melty cheddar for bold #Tex-Mex flavor. Made with simple ingredients, this easy comfort dinner is perfect for busy family nights. Ingredients: 5 Burrito Size Flour Tortillas 2 ½ cup Shredded Chicken ½ Packet Taco Seasoning 1 cup Sour Cream 1 cup Cheddar Cheese shredded 2 tablespoons Chopped Green Chilies 10 ounces Diced Tomatoes with Green Chilies undrained 1 pounds Queso Blanco Velveeta cubed Instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded chicken, taco seasoning, sour cream, shredded cheddar cheese, and chopped green chilies. Stir until everything is well mixed, then set the bowl aside. In a saucepan over medium-high heat, add the cubed Velveeta and the undrained can of diced tomatoes with green chilies. Stir occasionally until the cheese is completely melted and smooth. Lay the tortillas out on a flat surface. Spoon about ½ to ¾ cup of the chicken mixture into the center of each tortilla, then spread it slightly and roll it up to form a burrito. Repeat until all the tortillas are filled. Arrange the burritos side by side in a 9x13 casserole dish. Pour the warm queso evenly over the top of the burritos. Bake at 350°F for 20–25 minutes, until everything is heated through and bubbly. Serve hot and enjoy!

12/10 on flavor for this one. 🔥 @NicoleMcLaughlin is back with your easy dinner this week: Mississippi Chicken Casserole. It’s cheesy and creamy, and has that punch of flavor from the pepperoncini peppers that really takes it to the next level. Get the recipe below or tap the link in @allrecipes bio to try it for yourself! 🍽️ Ingredients:  4 ounces cream cheese, softened 1/2 cup sour cream 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese, divided 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted 1/4 cup brine from pepperoncini peppers 1 (1-ounce) package ranch dressing mix 1 (1-ounce) package au jus gravy mix 1 cup milk 3 cups wide egg noodles (6 ounces), cooked according to package directions 3 cups shredded cooked chicken 1 cup sliced pepperoncini peppers Directions:  Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Stir together cream cheese, sour cream, 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, melted butter, pepperoncini brine, ranch dressing mix, and au jus gravy mix in a large bowl until well combined. Stir in milk. Fold in cooked noodles, chicken, and pepperoncini peppers until evenly coated. Spread mixture into the prepared baking dish; sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese. Bake until hot and bubbly, 25 to 30 minutes 🎥: Nicole #mississippichickencasserole #chickencasserole #dinnerideas

Cheesy Broccoli, Chicken, and Rice Skillet is super easy to make and can be on the table in 30 minutes!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breast 2 tbsp butter  1 onion, chopped  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, and paprika  1 tbsp ranch seasoning  1 tbsp minced garlic 2 cups of chicken broth  1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed  2 cups chopped broccoli  1 1/2 cups shredded Colby Jack cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken into small pieces. Roughly chop broccoli into smaller pieces (just be careful not to chop too small or it will completely fall apart while cooking).  Add butter to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and onions and spread them out evenly in pan. Season with salt, pepper, paprika, and ranch seasoning.  Once chicken is almost cooked through add minced garlic. Add the rinsed rice, broccoli, and chicken broth. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover with a lid.  Let cook covered for about 18 minutes or until rice is cooked. Add about a cup of shredded cheddar cheese and stir. Top with more cheese and cover with the lid to let the cheese melt or pop it in the oven under the broiler for just a few minutes. Enjoy!
